extracted.intended_audience: experimental chymists and natural philosophers (early-modern readers assessing chemical hypotheses)
extracted.subtask_description: Assessing claims that particular substances (salts, sulphurs, mercuries, etc.) are elemental/principal constituents of mixt bodies, by examining experimental methods (fire, distillation, reagents), conditions, and evidence that products are truly elementary rather than artifacts or secondary compounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification of what division by fire determines elements
rubrics_metrics.description: It were to be wish'd, our Chymists had clearly inform'd us what kinde of Division of Bodies by Fire must determine the number of the Elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims that the fire 'analyzes' a mixt body into its elements must explicitly state the kind of heating/division used (open fire vs. distillation in a retort, degree and duration of heat, etc.) so readers can judge whether the produced heterogeneities should be counted as 'Elements'. Examples: Guajacum burnt in an open fire produces Ashes and Soot, while distilled in a retort yields Oil, Spirit, Vinegar, Water and Charcoal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report openness/closure of vessel and method of application of heat
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the Fire act on them when they are expos'd to the open Air, or shut up in close Vessels, and the degree of Fire by which the Analysis is attempted, are of no small moment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experimental reports must record whether analysis occurred in open air or closed vessels and the intensity of heat. Examples: camphire subliming white in a closed gentle heat but producing black unctuous soot in an open flame; coal kept in a perfectly closed glass will not calcine to ashes even in strong fire.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate that products are genuine elementary (hypostatical) principles
rubrics_metrics.description: The Fire even when it divides a Body into Substances of divers Consistences, does not most commonly analyze it into Hypostatical Principles, but only disposes its parts into new Textures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a process yields new substances, provide evidence they are irreducible/primal rather than newly configured compounds or textures. Tests should attempt further analysis and consider whether the 'product' retains the nature of the original or is merely a new concrete (caput mortuum, ashes, vitrified glass etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider and report non-thermal methods of separation
rubrics_metrics.description: There are divers Separations to be made by other means, which either cannot at all, or else cannot so well be made by the Fire alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate separations achieved by reagents, digestion, or mechanical means as legitimate analyses. Examples: aqua fortis (spirit of nitre) separates gold and silver; affusion of alkaline salts separates urinous volatile salts from sal ammoniac; digestive treatment of antimony with oil of vitriol yields an obtainable sulphur not extractable by fire alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Showability for specific bodies: fire must be shown to separate the alleged principles
rubrics_metrics.description: There are some mixt Bodies from which it has not been yet made appear, that any degree of Fire can separate either Salt or Sulphur or Mercury, much less all the Three.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each body claimed to yield salt/sulphur/mercury by fire, present direct experimental evidence. Counterexamples (e.g., gold resisting decomposition in long fusion) must be addressed; consider alternate explanations such as concealed grains or migration rather than true dissociation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control for volatilization and migration artefacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Some Bodies being of such a Texture that the Fire can drive them into the cooler and less hot part of the Vessels... more easily than it can divorce their Elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish between constituents actually decomposed and parts merely transported (sublimed, condensed elsewhere, or carried off as flowers/soots). Experimental setup must control for migration (collectors, location of condensates) and rule out that apparent separations are due to movement rather than decomposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclude disguised or compounded 'extractions' by rigorous examen
rubrics_metrics.description: The pretended Salts and Sulphurs being so far from being Elementary parts extracted out of the Bodie of Mercurie, that they are rather... De-compound Bodies, made up of the whole Metal and the Menstruum or other Additaments imploy'd to disguise it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a practitioner claims extraction of an element, perform strict examinations to determine whether the product is a genuine elementary substance or a compound/adulterated mixture produced by solvents/menstruums or added reagents. Example: alleged salts from quicksilver may be disguises that revert to running mercury upon careful testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess purity and volatility relative to known families
rubrics_metrics.description: The taste and smell of the Salt of Soot are exceeding differing from those of the Spirits of Guajacum... the former not only smells and tastes much less like a vegetable Salt, than like that of Harts-horn, and other Animal Concretes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Characterize separated substances by sensory, physical and chemical properties and compare to known families (vegetable vs. animal salts, volatile vs. fixed) to judge whether claimed 'elements' align with expected elemental behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accept separations obtained without fire as legitimate analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Some such distinct Substances may be obtain'd from some Concretes without Fire, as deserve no less the name of Elementary, than many that Chymists extort by the Violence of the Fire.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that gentle processes (sun heat, putrefaction in a dunghill, mild baths) can liberate volatile spirits or salts that merit being called principles. Examples: the sulphur of wine distilled by sun-beams or dunghill putrefaction liberating urinous salt from urine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terminology caution: elements vs. principles and allowance of vocabulary
rubrics_metrics.description: Those distinct Substances... may without very much Inconvenience be call'd the Elements or Principles of them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be explicit about terms used (Elements vs. Principles). While either term may be used, authors should note the impropriety or ambiguity and define how 'element' is being employed in their argument (not merely rely on customary naming).

rubrics_metrics.name: Require reproducibility and explicit reporting of experimental conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: If I had leasure to shew you how much the Operations of Fire may be diversify'd by Circumstances... I will first take notice to you, that Guajacum (for Instance) burnt with an open Fire in a Chimney, is sequestred into Ashes and Soot, whereas the same Wood distill'd in a Retort does yield far other Heterogeneities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experimental claims about elemental separations must include enough procedural detail (vessel types, heat source, degree and duration, any reagents or digestions used) to permit others to reproduce and evaluate whether observed products are robust or artefactual.
